question: What is the name of Pt. Ravi Shankar's autobiography?
solution:
The correct answer is** __My Life, My Music__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Ravi Shanka**r was a sitarist and composer from India.
 
• He was a sitar virtuoso who became the **world's best-known expert of North Indian classical music **in the second half of the twentieth century, influencing numerous artists in India and throughout the world.
 
• Shankar rose to prominence as the world's most well-known **exponent of Hindustani (North Indian) classical music, **performing alongside India's most illustrious percussionists and releasing scores of popular recordings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **My Life, My Music**, is an historical and the most interesting biography of the famous musician Pandit Ravi Shankar.
 
• It contains within it about how the most instrument Sitar is been played by the players.
 
• ​Ravi Shankar was one of India's** greatest musical virtuosos.**​ He was renowned for his efforts to introduce Indian music to the West and for his influence on American and British popular music
